name: gitlab
description: Work with GitLab projects, issues, and merge requests using the user's own token. Load for project/issue/MR reads, searches, creating issues and notes.

content.inline:
## GitLab
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://gitlab.com/api/v4` with `bearerSecret: "s/GITLAB_TOKEN"` (a personal access token: Preferences -> Access Tokens; grant the `api` or `read_api` scope). Only the secret reference goes in the request; never the token.

Common calls:
- Whoami: `GET /user`
- Your projects: `GET /projects?membership=true&per_page=100&order_by=last_activity_at`
- Project issues: `GET /projects/{id}/issues?state=opened&per_page=100` (`{id}` is the numeric project id, or the URL-encoded `group/project` path)
- One issue: `GET /projects/{id}/issues/{iid}`
- Create issue: `POST /projects/{id}/issues` body `{title, description?, labels?}`
- Comment: `POST /projects/{id}/issues/{iid}/notes` body `{body}`
- Merge requests: `GET /projects/{id}/merge_requests?state=opened`
- Search: `GET /search?scope=issues&search=<encoded>`

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors are `{message}` or `{error}`. 401 = bad/expired token; 404 usually means the token lacks access to that project.
- A path `{id}` like `group/name` must be URL-encoded to `group%2Fname` with `v/ops/jvm/url-encode`.
- Results paginate; follow the `Link` header `rel="next"` or pass `page`.
